Changes With No Visible Difference in These Pictures

WhatChange
Buttons, links, icons, focus ring (all DBIM modes)Key colour at rest and shade 2 on hover, from the tokens. Most DBIM components set their own colours, so this shows mainly in shared design-system parts such as buttons and the focus ring.
Grey ladderNo more #fafafa, #f5f5f5, #454545, #2c2c2c or #151515 in a DBIM mode; each snaps to a published DBIM grey or the ink.
Indian-script fontsNoto Sans for all nine scripts, loaded only when a page contains that script. Measured: an English page downloads the same 4 font files as before; Bengali text loads Noto Sans Bengali.
